license_note: The model card states in prose that the overall GLM-Image model is released under the MIT License and that the VQ tokenizer and vision-encoder weights taken from X-Omni remain under Apache-2.0, so both licences govern parts of the weights. The Hugging Face repository ships no LICENSE file, so the MIT grant rests on the card's statement; the GitHub repository carries an Apache-2.0 LICENSE file dated 2026 for its code, which the card does not reconcile with the MIT statement. All named licences are open and no field-of-use restriction appears, so the release is classified as mixed open licenses. The Z.ai API serving glm-image is governed separately by the Z.ai Terms of Use and Additional Terms for API Services.

access_boundary: This record represents the zai-org/GLM-Image weight release announced January 14, 2026 (repository last modified 2026-01-15) together with the glm-image model served on the Z.ai API. The GLM-4 text and vision lines, the CogView models, the Z.ai API and chat products, ModelScope mirrors, and downstream quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated Safetensors weights with a documented diffusers pipeline and an SGLang pipeline, plus a published technical blog
The same release is served on the first-party Z.ai API as glm-image, with the model identifier documented
tradeoffs: No MIT licence text ships with the weights, the card's MIT statement sits beside an Apache-2.0 repository licence file, and two components carry their own Apache-2.0 terms
No versioning or deprecation policy is published for the model
